title: BXSS Event
description: Canonical content model for a single event. Designed to be source-agnostic: the same shape can be produced by WordPress/ACF (via a REST endpoint), a headless CMS, a Laravel/Node API, a static JSON file, or a mobile app backend, and consumed unchanged by the Phase 3 Event Design System (EDS) components. See event-data-model.md for the full field reference and component mapping.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. UUID recommended for a database-backed source; WordPress can use the post ID cast to string.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, kebab-case. Maps to the WordPress post_name / the route segment for a headless front-end.

basicInfo.description: Identity and taxonomy fields - everything needed to list, filter, and title an event before rendering its full page.

shortName.description: Compact name for nav pills, related-event cards, sticky CTA bar (space-constrained UI).

examples: Connecting Manufacturers, Investors & Trade Bodies Under One Roof

tagline.description: Very short marketing line, distinct from subtitle - optional, for ad copy / social cards.

description.description: Full rich-text/markdown/HTML description for the About/Overview section.

shortDescription.description: 1-2 sentence plain-text summary, for meta description, search results, and related-event cards.

category.description: Single primary category. Recommend a controlled vocabulary (WP taxonomy term / CMS enum), not free text.

industry.description: Multiple industry sectors covered (many-to-many). Powers the Industries Covered tag cloud (.eds-tag).

tags.description: Free-form tags for search/filtering, separate from the controlled 'industry' taxonomy.

featured.description: Whether this event should surface in featured slots (homepage, related-events 'featured' relation).

priority.description: Manual sort weight, higher = more prominent, for admin-controlled ordering independent of date.

status.description: Deliberately split into three independent concerns - a CMS publish state, a derived event lifecycle, and a registration state - since they change independently (a published, upcoming event's registration can still be 'sold-out').

lifecycleStatus.description: Can be stored, or computed at request time from timing.startDate/endDate - either is valid for a consuming API.

registrationStatus.description: Drives .eds-badge--success|warning|danger|neutral in the Registration Status / Event Status Badge components.

timing.description: Powers the Countdown Block (data-countdown-date), Quick Info Strip, and Agenda day-tabs.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-09-14T10:00:00+05:00 - matches data-countdown-date exactly.

durationDays.description: Can be stored or computed from startDate/endDate; stored here for APIs that prefer not to do date math client-side.

recurring.description: Optional. Supports an annual/recurring exhibition (e.g. 'edition 6 of an annual summit') without duplicating shared content.

parentSeriesId.description: Links this edition back to a shared 'event series' record, if one exists.

hero.description: Overrides for the Event Hero component. All fields optional and fall back to basicInfo (name/subtitle/description) if omitted - a CMS editor should not have to fill in the hero separately unless they want different hero-specific copy.

title.description: Falls back to basicInfo.name if null.

subtitle.description: Falls back to basicInfo.subtitle if null.

cta.description: Powers the Hero CTA Group (.eds-cta-group). Typically 1-2 items (primary + outline).

statistics.description: Compact stat row inside the hero (.eds-hero-stats) - a SUBSET of the full 'statistics' array below, chosen for hero prominence. Kept separate so the hero doesn't have to show all stats.

badge.description: Overrides the auto-derived status badge if the organizer wants custom hero badge text (e.g. 'Early Bird Pricing Ends Soon' instead of just 'Registration Open').

speakers.description: One event -> many speakers. Powers the Speaker Grid / Speaker Card / Featured Speaker Card components.

sponsors.description: One event -> many sponsors, grouped by tier at render time (group sponsors[] by .tier - do not model tiers as separate arrays, so adding a new tier never requires a schema change).

agenda.description: One event -> many days -> many sessions. Modeled as days containing sessions (not a flat session list with a date field) because the Agenda Preview component's day-tabs need sessions pre-grouped for O(1) render per tab.

registration.description: Registration mechanics, separate from status.registrationStatus (which is the display-facing badge state) so capacity/pricing can change without touching the status enum.

seatsLeft.description: Null/omitted means 'not tracked' - UI should not render a seats-left indicator in that case, not render '0'.

pricingTiers.description: Placeholder structure only, per Phase 4 scope (no real payment/booking system yet).

statistics.description: Generic, extensible list rather than fixed fields (visitors/exhibitors/countries/... are conventions, not hardcoded schema properties) - see event-data-model.md for the recommended 'key' vocabulary. This is what lets a CMS editor add a new stat type (e.g. 'Workshops Hosted') without a schema/API change.

relatedEvents.description: References OTHER event ids, not embedded event objects - keeps the schema normalized (an API should resolve these ids to summary objects at request time, e.g. via ?include=relatedEvents).

alt.description: Required for real accessibility, but Phase 4 only mandates the field exist (see rules.txt - accessibility audit is a future phase).

socialLinks.description: All optional - a component should hide any icon whose URL is null/absent rather than rendering a dead link.

mapUrl.description: A shareable Google Maps link (Get Directions button).

mapEmbedUrl.description: The embeddable iframe src, kept separate from mapUrl since they are different URL formats. Null -> render .eds-map-placeholder-empty instead of a broken iframe.

amenities.description: Generic list replacing separate 'parking'/'transportation'/'nearbyFacilities' booleans - each amenity is {icon, label} so new amenity types never need a schema change. 'Nearby Hotels' is intentionally its own array below since it needs more fields (name, distance, link) than a simple amenity tag.

bio.description: Powers the Speaker Detail Card's expandable bio.

order.description: Manual display order within the Speaker Grid.

featured.description: True -> render with .eds-speaker-card--featured instead of the default card.

tier.description: Maps directly to the .eds-sponsor-card--{tier} modifier classes (Phase 3). 'title' is the highest tier, rendered like 'premium' in the CSS - see event-data-model.md for the exact tier-to-modifier table.

category.description: Optional free-text sub-label if a tier needs further grouping (e.g. tier='partner', category='Technology Partner').

label.description: Optional override for the tab label, e.g. 'Day 1 · Sep 14' instead of an auto-generated one.

time.description: Display-formatted start time (e.g. '10:00 AM') or an ISO time - either is acceptable, document the choice per implementation.

speakerIds.description: References into the event's own speakers[] array by id - many-to-many (a session can have multiple speakers; a speaker can appear in multiple sessions).

category.description: Optional track label if the agenda has parallel tracks (e.g. 'Manufacturing Track').

key.description: Machine-readable identifier. See event-data-model.md for the conventional vocabulary (visitors, exhibitors, countries, speakers, sessions, sponsors, areaSqm, expectedAttendance) - not enforced here so new stat types never require a schema change.

value.description: Maps to data-target on .eds-stat-num / [data-eds-counter] for the Animated Counter.

thumbnailUrl.description: For videos - required in practice for .eds-video-card, optional in schema (falls back to url).

category.description: Powers optional FAQ Category Tabs (.eds-tabs) grouping.

rating.description: Null -> omit the Rating Block entirely rather than rendering 0 stars.
